name: checking nothing reports READY, which is the vacuous pass this script exists to refuse
expect: nothing checked is CANNOT RUN, not READY

name: a pull request whose CI never started reads as green
expect: no checks reported is CANNOT RUN, not a vacuous pass

name: a still-running CI run is read as settled
edits:
if any(b == "pending" for b in buckets):
    if False:
expect: a pending check is not a pass

name: the key-indent restriction is dropped, so a nested `if:` shadows the step's own
expect: an `if:` inside a run: body does not shadow the step's own condition

name: a draft pull request reads as mergeable
the PR head stops being compared to the local HEAD, so --pr can point anywhere
expect: a PR whose head is not the local HEAD is refused

name: a folded scalar stops being followed, so `if: >` yields an empty condition
expect: a FOLDED condition (`if: >`) is read from its continuation lines

name: the allowance stops being a count, so a second copy rides in on the first's ticket
edits:
if seen[key] > allowed:
        if key not in ACCOUNTED_MENTIONS:
expect: a SECOND copy of an approved line is unaccounted — the allowance is a count

name: commented-out mentions stop being skipped, so prose about a gate reads as one
expect: a commented-out mention is not a gate and is not flagged
